verdict.rationale: three.js is fully open-source on GitHub (mrdoob/three.js), with public git clone access, migration guides, and release notes documenting engine internals, giving developers direct read/modify access to the full source; community testimonials confirm developers have forked/extended it for custom games. missing for 10: explicit license text citation and hands-on evidence of a developer patching core engine internals to solve a blocker.
